notes: Corrected ὁ καὶ Παῦλος: the accepted reading gave *who* to the article and folded only *is … called* onto the name. Rule 92 governs an expressed appositional predicate noun recast as a finite relative clause — the noun carries the relativizer and copula, and the article keeps only a determiner or antecedent pronoun the ASV writes, of which there is none here.
